[DeepMutation](https://lilicoding.github.io/papers/ma2018deepmutation.pdf) establishes direct model mutations without retraining, suitable for frozen CNNs. However, output differences alone do not establish useful fault detection. [MuFF](https://arxiv.org/abs/2501.09846) identifies instability, poor killability and low sensitivity in existing post-training operators; its weight/neuron inhibitors incorporate stability checks. [DeepCrime](https://huang.isis.vanderbilt.edu/cs8395/readings/testing-dl.pdf) emphasizes killable but nontrivial mutants and discrimination between weak and strong test suites. Its training-distribution statistical framework requires adaptation for a single frozen checkpoint.

Recommended calibration, synthesized from these findings: run unchanged-model repeats, clone/save–reload controls, and zero-severity mutations through the identical injection pipeline. Fix evaluation mode, preprocessing and precision; measure clean numerical variation before setting detection tolerances. Record each sampled mutation site, whether its value actually changed, whether exercised inputs produce a local activation difference, and whether that difference reaches logits or decisions. Distinguish site coverage, propagation and detection. A surviving mutant is not proven equivalent; distinguish demonstrated equivalence, observed inactivity and unresolved survival. Report raw scores alongside explicitly justified exclusions and operator/site-stratified results.

Sweep severity from identity through subtle to destructive changes; report detection curves, clean false-positive rates, prediction disagreement and accuracy loss rather than one pooled kill rate. Predeclare sampling across layers, channels and operator families, retaining difficult survivors instead of selecting only detectable faults. Calibrate thresholds on separate inputs and operators, then freeze them before evaluating held-out mutation families and sites. These are proposed experimental safeguards, not a standardized protocol established by the cited papers. Generalization beyond the mutations used to design the detector is the central check against circular validation.
